if: a useful life or residual value for a specific asset has been notified for accounting purposes by a Regulatory Authority constituted under an Act of Parliament, or by the Central Government
then: that useful life or residual value SHALL be applied in calculating the depreciation to be provided for that asset, irrespective of the requirements of Schedule II
source_section: Companies Act, 2013, Schedule II, Part B, paragraph 4
note: A precedence rule, not an option: Part B displaces Part C for the named asset. Part C states the same ordering from the other side, opening 'Subject to Parts A and B above'. The printed paragraph 4 is NOT the 2013 enactment — the Schedule's own footnote records substitution by Notification G.S.R. 627(E) dated 29 August 2014. UNKNOWN — source is the Act as enacted 2013; amendments not held locally.
